title: Pieces Not Labeled
text: Pieces Not Labeled. My husband is very handy and has put together all kinds of furniture pieces over the years. This one was not difficult, but it was a pain because the pieces were labeled! He had to keep holding individual pieces up and trying to match them up. The whole process took nearly an hour. The finished nightstand is decent. It's sturdy enough. It's a bit short and would be best for beds that are nearer to the ground. There are 2 drawers, but they don't use usual metal hardware that drawers use. The drawers open and close fine for now, but I do wonder how long they will hold up. A cheap screwdriver is provided, but my husband used his power tools instead. It's not a terrible nightstand, it's not a high quality one either. This would be a good fit for someone just starting out or a college student.
